t2.thesis: An abrupt CEO departure amid scandal right before earnings creates high risk of an interim CEO kitchen-sink guidance reset, outweighing oversold relief potential.
reasons: Jensen Huang's sudden resignation just days before earnings introduces immense governance uncertainty and executive distraction.
Interim CEO Colette Kress has a strong incentive to set a conservative, de-risked forward guidance baseline for Q4 FY27.
Options skew strongly favors puts with elevated IV (ATM IV/RV60 at 2.75x) reflecting institutional hedging against further headline fallout.
While the stock is heavily oversold (-27% in 1 month), unconfirmed comeback rumors and elevated capex commitments ($279B supply, $105B guarantees) leave little margin for guidance disappointment.
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 FY27 revenue and gross margin guidance delivered by interim CEO Colette Kress relative to street expectations.

prior.from: semis cluster base rate (0.479 across 434 historical events)

t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down from 0.48 to 0.45 due to severe executive transition friction and heightened odds of a conservative forward guide, partly mitigated by sharp pre-earnings price compression.

theses.expected: Conservative Q4 revenue guidance below street whispers and cautious commentary on hyperscaler financing arrangements cause a negative overnight gap.
theses.mechanism: Interim leadership typically de-risks multi-quarter forward expectations to manage execution risk during a CEO search.
theses.wrong_if: Management delivers blowout Q3 results, guides Q4 comfortably above $115B, and decisively quells operational continuity concerns.

theses.expected: A clean operational beat is overshadowed by analyst scrutiny on governance, executive transition timelines, and commitments.
theses.mechanism: The conference call becomes dominated by questions regarding Huang's departure and strategic direction rather than product demand.
theses.wrong_if: The board announces an accelerated succession plan or resolves the underlying controversy cleanly.

theses.expected: Extremely depressed sentiment and massive short-term hedging trigger a sharp relief squeeze upon solid Vera Rubin shipment execution.
theses.mechanism: The stock having fallen over 12% in 5 days creates an asymmetric upside bar if Q3 core Data Center growth simply meets the $108B target.
theses.wrong_if: Guidance cuts or customer deployment pushbacks validate the recent heavy selling.

key_observations: Q4 FY27 revenue guidance range compared to the Q3 guide of $108B
Tone and forward strategic roadmap articulated by interim CEO Colette Kress
Updates on Vera Rubin production yields, supply commitments ($279B), and gigascale financing MOUs
Any commentary addressing governance investigations or board leadership stability
